fichas.title: Kitchen place settings and plates
fichas.summary: Illustrations compare four place settings, from a meal with soup, meat dish, dessert, and drink to a more elaborate setting including starter, fish, meat, dessert, and wine. A separate illustration shows plates in 12-piece sets.

fichas.title: Stackable pans and cookware
